g.title: blender
g.text: SF016 documented original-style Blender — own connectivity schematic
S1/S2 are SPDT: choose one throw; normal Tone connection shown by switch label.
SU/SL Sustain10k; TH/TL Tone25k; LU/LL Level50k; BU/BL Blend100k: electrical midpoints.
Intrinsic BJT/Ge charge and leakage are in the netlist, not extra board parts.
